native_assessment_definition.standard: 2021–22 four-level regular MCAP standards; 2024–25 Math includes accelerated Algebra 1, Geometry and Algebra 2 with applicable grade 6–7 course waiver; DLM remains separate

count_definition_status.reason: Native administrative counts/grade-course sums are source evidence only; exact valid-score business rules and ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified. Income and enrollment never substitute or select model membership.

release_basis.note: Only this separately validated exact 2024–25 regular MCAP grade-school point-only contract is approved. Source and numerical historical audits remain immutable with false approvals; compact references require available unchanged artifacts/code/tests/policy and current semantic replay on every validation/import. High, mixed, primary, unknown, unmatched and closed scopes, valid-score counts and the scored floor remain held.
